title: A2AClusterConfig
description: The v1 bus and gateway configuration (config/a2a_config.json). Only the keys listed here are read by the code.

primary_master.description: Reported to gateway clients as cluster_master after authentication

public_key_or_secret_name.description: For HMAC, the name of the environment variable that holds the shared secret (never the secret itself); for Ed25519, the agent's base64 public key, written inline

role_scope.description: Shown by scripts/a2a_bus.py status; not enforced

key_type.description: The registered key's algorithm; only signatures made with it verify. Omitted: ed25519 for an inline Ed25519 public key, else hmac

revocation_list.description: Agent ids that are denied immediately

enabled.description: Shown by scripts/a2a_bus.py status; the gateway itself is started with scripts/run_server.py
